text: 4.92 Export and import of Diamond, Gemstone & Jewellery on consignment basis (a) Policy for export and import of diamond, gemstone and jewellery on consignment basis is given in paragraph 4.53 of FTP. (b) Detailed procedure in this regard shall be governed as per the relevant Customs Rules & Regulations.
